digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Rebar has no aggregation layer to query agent-driven dev loop trends over time or surface code-health movement persisted across runs.

Three agent-lifecycle signal categories leave no durable event-store trace today: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused a bug), and bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky).

Blame-based caused_by auto-derivation must run after bug close and write links directly to bypass closed-source guards, with explicit --caused-by override always winning and auto-derived edges labeled as non-authoritative (classified confidence only).

The rebar metrics command must surface every available metric across agent-process, gate-economics, and code-health lenses with structured unavailable states that light up automatically as data accrues, requiring no future code changes.

Bug-close friction must remain flat: the required free-text --reason argument is replaced (not supplemented) with a bounded --class enum persisted on the STATUS event, keeping required-argument count at exactly one.

All backfilled or classified metric values must be labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, never aggregated into authoritative structural series, with durable sources (event store, git blame, gate sidecars) preferred over new passive emissions.
